Subject: Quick confirmation: residency & private-peering guarantees for RFP

Irene —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our RFP packet we need a short, signed confirmation that Redwood can: (1) guarantee that BrightHealth customer data will be processed and stored only in the regions we select (US-East / EU-West); and (2) support a private peering/VPC deployment with dedicated egress controls and KMS partitioning.

Can you provide a one-page commitment letter and a short technical Q&A that we can include in procurement? We have tight timelines — procurement needs a draft by Monday EOD (UTC).

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: residency & private-peering guarantees for RFP

Elena —

Thanks for the note and the timeline. We can provide the materials you requested. High-level answers up front so procurement can proceed:

- Residency commitment: Redwood will ensure customer data for BrightHealth is processed and stored only in the selected regions (US-East and EU-West). This includes model inference, logging, and backups tied to the customer tenancy.
- Private peering / VPC: We support VPC peering and private endpoints for both Hosted-Private (customer VPC with Private Connect) and Private (on-prem/VPC) deployments. Egress policies can be restricted via ACLs and route tables.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM; keys can be scoped per-tenant and per-region.

I'm attaching a short commitment letter and a network diagram. Marcus Lin from Infra is looped in to provide a technical Q&A and the KMS partitioning matrix.

We will deliver: signed one-page commitment letter (PDF), VPC connection diagram (PNG), and a KMS partitioning CSV with recommended key scope. Please confirm if you want Redwood legal to sign with an initial or a final signed PDF for the RFP.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- residency_commitment_letter.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
- vpc_connection_diagram.png (PNG, 220KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick confirmation: residency & private-peering guarantees for RFP

Hi Elena —

Adding a few technical clarifications based on typical procurement questions:

1) Network isolation: For Hosted-Private we provision dedicated VPCs per tenant in the target region. Traffic between BrightHealth and Redwood flows over a private peering link; public internet is not used for inference traffic. We can provide subnet CIDR ranges and a sample route-table configuration for your network team.

2) Egress controls: Egress is limited via NAT gateways and route policies. If you require deny-by-default, we can provide a hardened baseline with explicit allow lists.

3) KMS partitioning: We recommend a per-tenant, per-region key strategy. See attached kms_partitioning_matrix.csv for an example mapping: key alias, region, tenant_id_prefix, usage (data-at-rest / logs / backups). Customer-managed KMS is supported for EU and US regions; HSM-backed keys available for Enterprise Private deployments.

4) Audit & evidence: We can furnish HA network diagrams, peering runbook steps (BGP config sample), and network capture checks during onboarding. SOC 2 control mappings for network segregation are also available on request.

If you want, we can run a 30-min technical sync next week to walk your infra and security teams through the diagram and the key model.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
